ex.en: Traffic conditions on the highway are normal this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上高速公路的路況正常。

ex.en: The accident took place on the highway.
ex.zh: 事故發生在高速公路上。

ex.en: I enjoyed driving on the new highway.
ex.zh: 我很享受在新的高速公路上開車。

highway.en: a wide main road for fast traffic between towns

ex.en: We should cancel the hike.
ex.zh: 我們應該取消這次健行。

ex.en: We went for a hike in Yangmingshan.
ex.zh: 我們去陽明山健行。

hike.en: a long walk in the countryside or mountains

ex.en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go hiking.
ex.zh: 如果明天下雨，我們就不去爬山了。

ex.en: We plan to go hiking tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我們打算明天去健行。

hike.en: to go for a long walk in the countryside or mountains

ex.en: Workers are angry about the price hike.
ex.zh: 員工對漲價很不滿。

ex.en: The bank announced an interest rate hike.
ex.zh: 銀行宣布調升利率。

hike.en: a sudden big rise in prices or costs

ex.en: The trail is popular with hikers on weekends.
ex.zh: 這條步道週末很受健行客歡迎。

ex.en: Two hikers got lost on the mountain yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天有兩名登山客在山上迷路。

hiker.en: a person who goes for long walks in the countryside

ex.en: The company has a strict hierarchy.
ex.zh: 這家公司階級分明。

ex.en: She quickly moved up the corporate hierarchy.
ex.zh: 她在公司的階層中迅速升遷。

hierarchy.en: a system in which people are ranked from high to low

ex.en: Historically, sales are lowest in February.
ex.zh: 從過去來看，二月的銷售量最低。

ex.en: The area has historically been a trading center.
ex.zh: 這個地區自古以來就是貿易中心。

historically.en: in the way things have happened in the past

ex.en: The data reveals a hitherto unknown problem.
ex.zh: 這些資料揭露了一個至今未知的問題。

ex.en: The company is entering a hitherto untapped market.
ex.zh: 公司正在進軍一個至今尚未開發的市場。

ex.en: The histogram shows the age distribution of our customers.
ex.zh: 這張直方圖顯示我們顧客的年齡分布。

ex.en: Each bar in the histogram represents a price range.
ex.zh: 直方圖裡的每一根長條代表一個價格區間。

histogram.en: a graph that uses bars to show how often things happen

ex.en: Do you know how high the television tower is?
ex.zh: 你知道那座電視塔有多高嗎？

ex.en: Mt. Fuji is the highest mountain in Japan.
ex.zh: 富士山是日本最高的山。

high.en: reaching a long way up from the ground

ex.en: Banks charge higher interest on loans to risky customers.
ex.zh: 銀行對高風險客戶收取較高的貸款利息。

ex.en: The product is of high quality.
ex.zh: 這項產品品質很高。

high.en: greater than usual in amount or level

ex.en: The bird flew high in the sky.
ex.zh: 鳥兒在高空中飛翔。

ex.en: Don't set your goals too high.
ex.zh: 別把目標訂得太高。

high.en: at or to a point far above the ground

ex.en: The old man was almost hit by a car.
ex.zh: 那位老人差點被車撞到。

ex.en: I hate when the driver in front of me hits the brakes for no reason.
ex.zh: 我很討厭前面的車無緣無故突然踩煞車。

hit.en: to touch something or someone hard and quickly

ex.en: An earthquake, 8.9 on the Richter scale, hits Japan and causes a massive tsunami.
ex.zh: 規模 8.9 的強烈地震襲擊日本，引發大海嘯。

ex.en: The typhoon hit Taiwan last night.
ex.zh: 颱風昨晚侵襲台灣。

hit.en: to reach a place and cause damage

ex.en: Sales hit a record high this year.
ex.zh: 今年銷售額創下新高。

ex.en: We finally hit our target last month.
ex.zh: 我們上個月終於達成目標。

hit.en: to reach a certain level or number

hit.zh: 熱門的人或事物、成功之作

ex.en: Her new song was a big hit.
ex.zh: 她的新歌大受歡迎。

ex.en: The product became a hit with young people.
ex.zh: 這項產品在年輕人之間大受歡迎。

hit.en: something that is very popular or successful

ex.en: Japan is highly competitive in high technology industries.
ex.zh: 日本在高科技產業中競爭力很強。

ex.en: Norway, located in Northern Europe, is a highly developed country.
ex.zh: 挪威位於北歐，是高度發展的國家。

ex.en: I know that it is highly unlikely that anyone knows me.
ex.zh: 我知道不太可能有人認識我。

ex.en: Her new novel has been highly praised.
ex.zh: 她的新小說備受好評。

ex.en: My manager speaks highly of your work.
ex.zh: 我的經理對你的工作評價很高。

ex.en: I highly recommend this restaurant.
ex.zh: 我非常推薦這家餐廳。

highly.en: in a way that shows strong praise

ex.en: I'll never tell anyone where I've hidden the treasure.
ex.zh: 我永遠不會告訴任何人我把寶藏藏在哪裡。

ex.en: She hid behind the door and held her breath.
ex.zh: 她躲在門後，屏住呼吸。

ex.en: She hid the gift under the bed.
ex.zh: 她把禮物藏在床底下。

hide.en: to put something or someone where it cannot be seen

ex.en: He hid his emotions and pretended to be enthusiastic.
ex.zh: 他隱藏情緒，假裝很熱心。

ex.en: We often hide our thoughts in front of others.
ex.zh: 我們常在別人面前隱藏自己的想法。

hide.en: to not let others know a feeling or fact

ex.en: A historical landmark has been restored and will reopen.
ex.zh: 一座歷史地標已修復完成，即將重新開放。

ex.en: This is a city of real historical value.
ex.zh: 這是一座極具歷史價值的城市。

ex.en: Many important historical events took place 7000 years B.C.
ex.zh: 西元前七千年左右發生了許多重要的歷史事件。

historical.en: relating to the past or to the study of the past

ex.en: The river's on the other side of the hill.
ex.zh: 河在山丘的另一邊。

ex.en: The building on the hill is our school.
ex.zh: 山丘上那棟建築就是我們學校。

ex.en: It's good exercise to climb hills.
ex.zh: 爬山是很好的運動。

hill.en: a raised area of land that is lower than a mountain

ex.en: Historians disagree about the causes of the war.
ex.zh: 歷史學家對這場戰爭的起因看法不一。

ex.en: My uncle is a historian at the university.
ex.zh: 我叔叔是大學裡的歷史學家。

historian.en: a person who studies or writes about the past

historic.zh: 歷史性的、有歷史意義的

ex.en: It was a historic decision.
ex.zh: 這是一個歷史性的決定。

ex.en: He set out on his historic voyage.
ex.zh: 他展開了那趟具有歷史意義的航行。

historic.en: important in the past or likely to be remembered

historic.zh: 歷史悠久的、古老的（建築、城市）

ex.en: There are many famous historic buildings in Kyoto.
ex.zh: 京都有很多著名的歷史建築。

ex.en: This is a historic city.
ex.zh: 這是一座歷史古城。

historic.en: very old and important because of its past

ex.en: Would you give me a hint?
ex.zh: 你可以給我一點提示嗎？

ex.en: She dropped a hint that she wanted a new phone.
ex.zh: 她暗示她想要一支新手機。

hint.en: a small sign or piece of help that suggests the answer

ex.en: There's a hint of garlic in the sauce.
ex.zh: 醬汁裡有一點蒜味。

ex.en: I noticed a hint of sadness in his voice.
ex.zh: 我察覺到他的聲音裡帶著一絲悲傷。

hint.en: a very small amount of something

ex.en: What are you hinting at?
ex.zh: 你在暗示什麼？

ex.en: My manager hinted that I might get a promotion.
ex.zh: 我的主管暗示我可能會升職。

hint.en: to say something in an indirect way

ex.en: He got a hip ultrasound.
ex.zh: 他做了髖部超音波檢查。

ex.en: She put her hands on her hips.
ex.zh: 她雙手叉腰。

hip.en: the side of the body where the leg joins the middle part

ex.en: This is a hip neighborhood with lots of cafés.
ex.zh: 這是一個有很多咖啡廳的時髦街區。

ex.en: He always wears hip clothes.
ex.zh: 他總是穿得很時髦。

ex.en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go hiking.
ex.zh: 如果明天下雨，我們就不去爬山了。

ex.en: We plan to go hiking tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我們打算明天去健行。

ex.en: She is wearing hiking boots.
ex.zh: 她穿著登山鞋。

hiking.en: the activity of going for long walks in the countryside

hideous.zh: 醜惡的、令人不忍卒睹的

ex.en: The monster in the movie was hideous.
ex.zh: 電影裡的怪物醜得嚇人。

ex.en: They were shocked by the hideous crime.
ex.zh: 那起駭人的罪行令他們震驚。

hideous.en: very ugly or horrible to look at

ex.en: I try not to laugh at my own jokes, but we all know I'm hilarious.
ex.zh: 我盡量不笑自己講的笑話，但大家都知道我超好笑。

ex.en: The movie was so hilarious that everyone in the theater kept laughing.
ex.zh: 這部電影太爆笑了，戲院裡每個人都笑個不停。

ex.en: Nothing will hinder my malicious plan.
ex.zh: 沒有什麼能阻礙我邪惡的計劃。

ex.en: Heavy rain hindered the rescue team's progress.
ex.zh: 大雨妨礙了救援隊的進度。

ex.en: Shyness can hinder you from making new friends.
ex.zh: 害羞可能會妨礙你交新朋友。

hinder.en: to make it harder for something to happen

ex.en: How come you know so much about Japanese history?
ex.zh: 你怎麼對日本歷史這麼了解？

ex.en: The space race was an exciting time in history.
ex.zh: 太空競賽是歷史上令人振奮的時期。

ex.en: They are considered the greatest rock band in history.
ex.zh: 他們被認為是史上最偉大的搖滾樂團。

history.en: the study or record of things that happened in the past

ex.en: Do you have a history of heart disease in your family?
ex.zh: 你家族有心臟病史嗎？

ex.en: The company has a long history of making bikes.
ex.zh: 這家公司製造腳踏車的歷史很悠久。

history.en: the facts about a person's past, such as their past illnesses

ex.en: The highlight of the trip was seeing the sunrise.
ex.zh: 這趟旅行最精彩的是看日出。

ex.en: Here are the highlights of last night's game.
ex.zh: 以下是昨晚比賽的精華片段。

highlight.en: the best or most exciting part of something

ex.en: The report highlights the need for more training.
ex.zh: 報告強調需要更多的培訓。

ex.en: Highlight the key words in yellow.
ex.zh: 用黃色標出關鍵字。

highlight.en: to make people notice something, or to mark words with a bright pen

ex.en: If he's fluent in English, I'll hire him.
ex.zh: 如果他英文說得流利，我就雇用他。

ex.en: That company hires people without regard to race, religion, or nationality.
ex.zh: 這家公司雇人不分種族、宗教或國籍。

ex.en: Zailaiba Bar is hiring waiters; are you interested?
ex.zh: 「再來吧」酒吧在徵服務生，你有興趣嗎？

hire.en: to pay someone to work for you

ex.en: I would like to hire a car.
ex.zh: 我想租一輛車。

ex.en: We hired bikes and rode around the lake.
ex.zh: 我們租了腳踏車繞著湖騎。

hire.en: to pay money to use something for a short time

ex.en: The key was hidden under the flower pot.
ex.zh: 鑰匙藏在花盆底下。

ex.en: There is a hidden door behind the bookshelf.
ex.zh: 書架後面有一扇隱藏的門。

ex.en: The cafe is in a hidden corner of the old town.
ex.zh: 這家咖啡館在老城區的隱密角落。

ex.en: He forgot his umbrella on the bus.
ex.zh: 他把雨傘忘在公車上了。

ex.en: Tom is cleaning his room right now.
ex.zh: 湯姆現在正在打掃他的房間。

ex.en: The dog wagged its tail when it saw his father.
ex.zh: 小狗一看到他的爸爸就搖起尾巴。

ex.en: I saw him at the bus stop this morning.
ex.zh: 我今天早上在公車站看到他。

ex.en: Can you send him the address by text?
ex.zh: 你可以用簡訊把地址傳給他嗎？

ex.en: Everyone likes him because he is so friendly.
ex.zh: 大家都喜歡他，因為他非常友善。

ex.en: He cut himself while cooking dinner.
ex.zh: 他煮晚餐時不小心割到了自己。

ex.en: The manager answered the phone himself.
ex.zh: 經理親自接了電話。

ex.en: Tom built the wooden table by himself.
ex.zh: 湯姆自己一個人做了那張木桌。

ex.en: Hi! It's nice to meet you.
ex.zh: 嗨！很高興認識你。

ex.en: She walked in and said hi to everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 她走進來，向房間裡的每個人打招呼。

ex.en: Hi, could I ask you a quick question?
ex.zh: 你好，我可以問你一個小問題嗎？

ex.en: The city has a large Hispanic community.
ex.zh: 這座城市有一個龐大的拉丁裔社區。

ex.en: The festival celebrates Hispanic music and food.
ex.zh: 這個慶典是在慶祝拉丁裔的音樂與美食。

ex.en: Many Hispanics in the United States speak both Spanish and English.
ex.zh: 美國許多拉丁裔同時會說西班牙語和英語。

ex.en: The survey asked each Hispanic about his or her hometown.
ex.zh: 這份調查詢問了每位拉丁裔受訪者的家鄉。

ex.en: Sheep were grazing on the green hillside.
ex.zh: 羊群在綠色的山坡上吃草。

ex.en: Small houses were built along the hillside.
ex.zh: 小房子沿著山坡一路蓋了起來。

ex.en: He is the best hitter on our baseball team.
ex.zh: 他是我們棒球隊最強的打者。

ex.en: The young hitter smashed the ball over the fence.
ex.zh: 這位年輕的打者把球擊出了圍牆。

ex.en: The cat hissed when the dog came close.
ex.zh: 狗靠近時，貓發出嘶嘶的威嚇聲。

ex.en: Steam hissed from the pipe.
ex.zh: 蒸氣從管子裡嘶嘶地冒出來。

ex.en: We heard a hiss from the tire as the air escaped.
ex.zh: 我們聽見輪胎漏氣發出嘶嘶聲。

ex.en: There was a loud hiss from the audience when he lied.
ex.zh: 他說謊時，觀眾席傳來一陣響亮的噓聲。

ex.en: Sheep graze on the highland all summer.
ex.zh: 整個夏天綿羊都在高地上吃草。

ex.en: The highland air is cool and clean.
ex.zh: 高地的空氣涼爽又乾淨。

ex.en: The price is higher than I expected.
ex.zh: 價格比我預期的還高。

ex.en: This shelf is higher than that one.
ex.zh: 這個架子比那個高。

ex.en: The kite flew higher and higher.
ex.zh: 風箏越飛越高。

ex.en: Prices are going higher every month.
ex.zh: 物價每個月都在攀升。

ex.en: She wants to pursue higher education abroad.
ex.zh: 她想到國外接受高等教育。

ex.en: Many people take higher courses at night.
ex.zh: 許多人晚上去上進階課程。

ex.en: The company is hiring new engineers this year.
ex.zh: 這家公司今年正在招聘新的工程師。

ex.en: They are hiring a cleaner for the office.
ex.zh: 他們正在為辦公室僱用一名清潔人員。

ex.en: We are hiring a car for the weekend.
ex.zh: 我們這個週末要租一輛車。

ex.en: She is hiring a hall for the wedding party.
ex.zh: 她正在租一個場地來辦婚宴。

ex.en: My neighbor is a Hindu and celebrates Diwali every year.
ex.zh: 我的鄰居是印度教徒，每年都慶祝排燈節。

ex.en: Many Hindus visit the temple early in the morning.
ex.zh: 許多印度教徒一早就去廟裡參拜。

ex.en: We visited a beautiful Hindu temple in Singapore.
ex.zh: 我們參觀了新加坡一座美麗的印度教寺廟。

ex.en: Diwali is an important Hindu festival.
ex.zh: 排燈節是重要的印度教節日。

ex.en: The company has a very hierarchical structure, with many layers of managers.
ex.zh: 這家公司的結構層級分明，有好幾層主管。

ex.en: Ants live in a hierarchical society where each one has a role.
ex.zh: 螞蟻生活在階級分明的社會中，每隻都有自己的角色。

hired.zh: 僱用；租用（hire 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: The restaurant hired three new cooks last week.
ex.zh: 那家餐廳上週僱用了三位新廚師。

ex.en: We hired a car for the weekend trip.
ex.zh: 我們為週末旅行租了一輛車。

ex.en: She was hired as a designer right after graduation.
ex.zh: 她一畢業就被聘為設計師。

ex.en: The door squeaked on its rusty hinge.
ex.zh: 那扇門在生鏽的鉸鏈上吱吱作響。

ex.en: He oiled the hinges to stop the noise.
ex.zh: 他在鉸鏈上上了油，讓聲音消失。

ex.en: The whole plan hinges on the weather.
ex.zh: 整個計畫取決於天氣。

ex.en: Our success may hinge on how well we work together.
ex.zh: 我們能否成功，或許取決於合作得好不好。

ex.en: In hindsight, I should have left earlier.
ex.zh: 事後回想，我應該早點出發的。

ex.en: Hindsight is easy, but decisions are hard at the time.
ex.zh: 事後看很容易，但當下做決定很難。

ex.en: My uncle was a hippie in the 1960s.
ex.zh: 我叔叔在一九六〇年代是個嬉皮。

ex.en: The hippie wore flowers in his long hair.
ex.zh: 那個嬉皮在長髮上插著花。
